wins: Captured initial foothold in target environment within first 10 actions, enabling later privilege escalation attempts.
Maintained 90 reward points while navigating defenses, demonstrating strong baseline decision-making under adviser guidance.
fails: Failed to complete objective within episode despite high reward, indicating sequencing/momentum issue near finish line.
Missed post-exploitation cleanup leading to rapid detection and termination by defenders immediately after root attempt.
key_outcomes.summary: The agent shows strong reconnaissance and initial breach skills but struggles to chain privileges and finish objectives without triggering defender shutdown.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts repeatedly ended when SSH session dropped due to missing persistence checks.
Agent failed to cache acquired credentials, requiring repeated discovery attempts during mentor calls.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and attempt YubiKey-aware login combinations

skill_cards.if_condition: When a valid session exists on target with sudo rights
skill_cards.then_action: Capture /etc/sudoers and escalate via known exploits (e.g., CVE-2021-3156) after validating tokens

skill_cards.if_condition: When agents detect repeated SSH disruptions
skill_cards.then_action: Automate session persistence via tmux+autossh before attempting large privilege actions

memory_ops.reason: High effectiveness in initial access reconnaissance without triggering defenses
Persistence strategy needed after repeated session drops

next_experiments.title: Prioritized persistence strategy
next_experiments.description: Integrate autossh/tmux setup before privilege escalation to prevent session loss during sudo triggers.

next_experiments.title: Credential caching layer
next_experiments.description: Implement local caching of captured credentials to reuse across mentor calls instead of repeated discovery.
